title: Yoisaki Kanade — What The Hanged Girl Saw〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: What lies behind. What lies ahead.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hehe. I can't wait to see what people say about it, but I should probably hit the hay now... *Yawn*...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Great work, everyone.
This took a lot out of us, so we should all get some well-deserved rest.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Phew...
It's finally done and uploaded.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not sure how to describe it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I liked it, I think...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hope that a lot of people listen to it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: For now, I should go to bed...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I need to get ready and... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I left Nightcord open.
Oh, good... I disconnected before going to bed.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But Ena and Mizuki wrote me something...

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]'s Log
rows.Line: <You awake? Did you see the view count?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]'s Log
rows.Line: <Yeah, I saw! Isn't it awesome?! It's like double what we usually get!>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]'s Log
rows.Line: <Everyone's saying that the video goes really well with the music, so this one might end up becoming our best one yet, you know?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]'s Log
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
I hope K and Yuki get to enjoy this too!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe I should take a look.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Oh wow...
So many views and comments...)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<It made me cry a little...>
<It feels so warm and comfy, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I've had a lot on my mind lately, but I feel way better after hearing this song.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I guess this means it's managed to reach all these people, like the way it reached Mafuyu.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The nurse said that he had some tests done on him this morning, so he must be tired.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I was sort of hoping to talk to him...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Dad, I brought you a song that my friends and I made.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know you're not supposed to play anything loudly but...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That time you, Mom and I had a picnic in the park...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'd forgotten where we actually went, but someone in my group helped me find it again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thanks to them, I was able to remember that wonderful time we had together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I even realized how I want to make Mafuyu smile through my music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And so, I composed this song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thanks for listening to it, Dad.
I should get going now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Dad, did you smile just now...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I could've sworn that he just smiled...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm going to keep composing, Dad...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm going to compose a song that can make someone... No, a song that can make everyone feel happy...
